T: A new comedy that proves there's more to attraction than meets the eye.
D: A dumped high school king bets he can turn the school's quiet art student into prom queen in six weeks.
P: Serve the fish tacos when Laney goes to the beach with Zack.
S: Laney works her shift in the falafel hat

Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, flour and salt to a coarse paste and roll into 16 balls. Fry in hot oil in batches until deep brown and crisp. Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, salt and water until pourable. Warm the pita, fill with falafel and tomato and drizzle with tahini.
2 x 400g tins chickpeas, drained and patted dry@Pantry
Taylor calls Laney vapor and spam

Cook the rice and season with the vinegar, caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Sear the Spam slices until crisp, then glaze with the soy and brown sugar. Press rice into blocks the size of the Spam and lay a slice on each. Wrap each with a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame.
340g tin SPAM luncheon meat, cut in 8 slices@Meat
M: Zack's hacky sack routine at the art show

Mix the mince, crumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in a hot pan. Add the passata, oregano and the rest of the garlic and simmer until thick. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with provolone and grill until melted. Tuck in the basil and serve.
Laney finally says yes to the beach

Rub the fish with the spices, oil and salt. Toss the cabbage with the juice of 2 limes and salt, and stir the chipotle into the sour cream. Grill the fish until just flaking, then break into chunks. Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, chipotle cream, coriander and lime.
W: Toss the strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar and leave to go juicy. Rub the butter into the flour and 60g sugar, stir in the buttermilk and pat out 3cm thick. Cut 4 rounds and bake at 210C until golden. Whip the cream with the vanilla, split the shortcakes and fill with berries and cream.
60g caster sugar, plus 2 tbsp for the berries@Pantry
K: Laney sees off Dean with a foghorn
Stir the pineapple and cranberry juices together in a punch bowl. Add the lime slices, frozen raspberries and ice. Top with lemonade just before serving.
